# glb-quality-gate

> GitHub Action that reviews every pull request that changes a GLB: diffs geometry, materials, textures and animation, posts one idempotent report and gates on a severity you choose.

glb-quality-gate is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
